༄༅/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs ngag 'don du bkod pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs ngag 'don du bkod pa bzhugs so//

rtsa ba gsum dang chos srung la// gus btud bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*// brtan bzhugs lhan cig ngag 'don du// bya phyir 'di ltar nyams su blang*// bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi// yan lag bdun gyis 'khod byas nas// na mo/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs bla ma yi dam dang*// mkha' 'gro chos srung bcas la bdag skyabs mchi// sems can thams cad 'khor ba las bsgral phyir// lam zab snying po nyams su blang bar bgyi| |pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi'i gdan steng du// bdag nyid skad cig hrīḥlas dbang chen rgyal// byu ru'i mdog 'dra khro nyams gar dgu ldan// spyi bor rta gdong dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs// gsang ba'i yum chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mthing dmar spyi bor phag zhal ngur sgra 'byin// gzig sham rus rgyan thod pa'i dum bus spras// skra grol nu 'bur bha ga bsgrad cing sbyor// yab yum gri thod g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ yig dkar dmar mthing*// de ltar gsal ba'i mdun mkhar gdong lnga dang*// gyad kyis bteg pa'i rin chen khri yangs dbus// sna tshogs chu skyes zla ba nyi ma'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma chos kyi grags pa ni// pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid dang dbyer med sku| |dkar dmar phyag g.yas sa gnon rdo rje dang*// g.yon pas mnyam bzhag dril bu 'dzin pa'i tshul// rab byung cha lugs mthang sham bla gos dang*| |snam sbyar lhub gyon bka' rtags paṇa zhwa ni// dmar ser rtse snyung brjid ldan dbu la mnabs// mtshan dpe rab ldan gzi brjid lhun sdug sku| |gnas gsum yig 'bru dkar dmar mthing 'od 'bar// de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras// rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho spyan drangs bstim// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rigs kun bdag por gyur// 'khor gyi tshul du rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas chos tshogs bcas// dam can rgya mtsho sprin phung lta bus bskor// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

mchod yon me tog spos dang mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg /rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags rdzas brgyad// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ma lus kun// dngos 'byor yid sprul blo yis blangs pa dang*// bdag lus ngag yid bcas te dbul bar bgyi// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// nyes pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*// chos gsung bskul zhing mya ngan mi 'da' gsol// dus gsum yod dge sems can don du bsngo| |kyai/ rtsa ba'i bla ma slob dpon pad+ma dngos// rigs kun khyab bdag chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so mos ldan bdag cag la// dbang bskur byin rlobs dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// 'khor 'das spyi dpal rdo rje slob dpon che// pad+ma badz+ra che mchog 'dus pa rtsal// gsol ba 'debs so mos ldan bdag cag la// dbang bskur byin rlobs dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// dkyil 'khor gtso bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i mtshan// gsang ba kun bdag thugs kyi rdo rje'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so mos ldan bdag cag la// dbang bskur byin rlobs dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa de srid du// 'gro kun don du dpal ldan bla ma mchog /mi 'gyur mi shigs zhabs pad rab brtan nas// bdag cag 'gro ba'i re ba skong du gsol// rtsa ba gsum dang sangs rgyas chos tshogs bcas// dam can rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs bden tshig dang*// bdag cag mos pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// gsol ba btab pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba las// dkar dmar mthing 'od bdud rtsi rab spros pas// bdag gi dpral mgrin snying thim sgo gsum gyi// sgrib sbyangs rdo rje gsum du smin byas nas// 'khor rnams gtsor thim gtso bo dgyes bzhin par// 'od du ltem zhu bdag gi smin mtshams thim| |bla ma'i gsang gsum bdag gi lus ngag yid// dbyer med nyid gyur ma bcos lhun 'byams ngang*// 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen por 'ub kyis chub// de yi dge tshogs rnam dkar ji snyed pa// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo// zhes pa'ang gtsang lha rtse'i phyogs nas dpal ri rin chen sgang gi bla ma karma bstan gsal gyis bskul ba'i ngor/

'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i lam la gnas pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ rang lo re gnyis pa me spre'u lo zla ba'i dkar po'i rdzogs pa dang po la/ 'bri chos phyug gi klung pho brang rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu mgyogs par bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
